sentences.en: They had to call off the concert because of the typhoon.
sentences.zh: 他們因為颱風必須取消演唱會。

sentences.en: The captain decided to call off the practice today.
sentences.zh: 隊長決定今天取消練習。

sentences.en: The mayor will call on the old people in our town.
sentences.zh: 市長將拜訪我們鎮上的老人家。

sentences.en: Our teacher plans to call on every student's family.
sentences.zh: 老師打算拜訪每個學生的家庭。

sentences.en: The doctor will call on the sick farmer this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 醫生今天下午會去探視那位生病的農夫。

sentences.en: Feel free to drop by when you pass my house.
sentences.zh: 你經過我家時歡迎順道進來坐。

sentences.en: I will drop by your shop on my way to work.
sentences.zh: 我上班路上會順道去你的店。

sentences.en: Grandma likes to drop by without telling us first.
sentences.zh: 奶奶喜歡不先講一聲就順道過來。

sentences.en: The baby fell asleep naturally after the long trip.
sentences.zh: 長途旅行後寶寶自然而然就睡著了。

sentences.en: Plants grow naturally in this warm valley.
sentences.zh: 植物在這個溫暖的山谷自然生長。

sentences.en: He is kind and honest by nature.
sentences.zh: 他天生善良又誠實。

sentences.en: The teacher uses pictures to explain new concepts.
sentences.zh: 老師用圖片來解釋新的概念。

sentences.en: My grandpa doesn't understand the concept of online shopping.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺不懂網路購物這個觀念。

sentences.en: Every student passed the test without exception.
sentences.zh: 每個學生都通過考試，沒有例外。

sentences.en: This rule has only one exception.
sentences.zh: 這條規定只有一個例外。

sentences.en: The old car stopped unexpectedly on the highway.
sentences.zh: 那台老車在高速公路上出乎意料地拋錨。

sentences.en: The movie was better than my expectation.
sentences.zh: 那部電影比我預期的還好。

sentences.en: The guest arrived unexpectedly before dinner.
sentences.zh: 客人在晚餐前出乎意料地到了。

sentences.en: The two teams went back to their respective rooms.
sentences.zh: 兩隊各自回到他們個別的休息室。

sentences.en: The players returned to their respective teams.
sentences.zh: 球員各自回到他們的隊上。

sentences.en: His homework is messy but still acceptable.
sentences.zh: 他的作業很亂但還算可以接受。

sentences.en: Wearing sport shoes is acceptable in our school.
sentences.zh: 在我們學校穿運動鞋是可以接受的。

sentences.en: Being ten minutes late is not acceptable here.
sentences.zh: 在這裡遲到十分鐘是不能接受的。

sentences.en: The car passed the safety inspection last week.
sentences.zh: 那台車上週通過安全檢查。

sentences.en: The factory has an inspection every month.
sentences.zh: 那家工廠每個月都有檢查。

sentences.en: Washing hands often can stop the infection.
sentences.zh: 常洗手可以阻止感染。

sentences.en: A bad cold is very infectious in a small room.
sentences.zh: 重感冒在小房間裡很容易傳染。

sentences.en: The doctor gave him medicine for the infection.
sentences.zh: 醫生給他治療感染的藥。

sentences.en: She sang the song perfectly at the show.
sentences.zh: 她在表演中把那首歌唱得很完美。

sentences.en: The two colors match perfectly in this photo.
sentences.zh: 這張照片裡兩個顏色搭配得剛剛好。

sentences.en: The chef won an award for his excellence.
sentences.zh: 那位廚師因為傑出的表現得獎。

sentences.en: He can excel in math if he practices more.
sentences.zh: 如果多練習，他的數學可以很出色。

sentences.en: Our school gave her a prize for excellence in art.
sentences.zh: 學校頒給她美術優異獎。

sentences.en: The police caught the murderer in two days.
sentences.zh: 警方兩天內抓到兇手。

sentences.en: Nobody knew that the quiet man was a murderer.
sentences.zh: 沒有人知道那個安靜的男人是兇手。

sentences.en: The story is about a murderer who felt sorry.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講一個感到後悔的兇手。

sentences.en: Two prisoners ran out of the jail last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有兩個囚犯逃出監獄。

sentences.en: The guard counted every prisoner before dinner.
sentences.zh: 警衛在晚餐前清點每一個囚犯。

sentences.en: The judge sent a dangerous criminal to jail for ten years.
sentences.zh: 法官把一個危險的罪犯關十年。

sentences.en: The police put a young criminal into the police car.
sentences.zh: 警察把一個年輕罪犯押上警車。

sentences.en: That criminal stole three cars in one night.
sentences.zh: 那個罪犯一個晚上偷了三台車。

sentences.en: Last year, the man committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 去年那名男子犯了罪。

sentences.en: This summer, the player committed to the team for three more years.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，這名球員承諾再為球隊效力三年。

sentences.en: The police arrested two men at the night market yesterday.
sentences.zh: 警察昨天在夜市逮捕了兩名男子。

sentences.en: The police will arrest anyone who drives after drinking.
sentences.zh: 警察會逮捕任何酒後開車的人。

sentences.en: The police will look into the missing bike case.
sentences.zh: 警方會調查那件腳踏車失竊案。

sentences.en: The teacher promised to look into the missing money.
sentences.zh: 老師答應要調查那筆不見的錢。

sentences.en: A reporter came to look into the strange noise at night.
sentences.zh: 一位記者來調查夜裡的怪聲音。

sentences.en: Please look over your answers before you hand it in.
sentences.zh: 交卷前請檢查你的答案。

sentences.en: My father likes to look over my report card.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸喜歡仔細看我的成績單。

sentences.en: The nurse will look over the machine before the test.
sentences.zh: 護士會在檢測前檢查那台機器。

sentences.en: We all look forward to the summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 我們都很期待暑假。

sentences.en: The children look forward to their first trip abroad.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很期待第一次出國旅行。

sentences.en: I look forward to meeting my cousin next month.
sentences.zh: 我很期待下個月見到我表哥。

sentences.en: There is a small crack on the rim of the cup.
sentences.zh: 杯子邊緣有一道小裂痕。

sentences.en: He held the cup by its rim and burned his finger.
sentences.zh: 他抓著杯緣結果燙到手指。

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet can stop you from getting injured.
sentences.zh: 戴安全帽可以避免你受傷。

sentences.en: He got a serious injury in the car accident.
sentences.zh: 他在車禍中受了重傷。

sentences.en: The player left the game because of a leg injury.
sentences.zh: 那位球員因為腿傷離場。

sentences.en: Wash the wound with clean water first.
sentences.zh: 先用乾淨的水沖洗傷口。

sentences.en: The soldier had a wound on his leg.
sentences.zh: 那名士兵的腿上有一道傷口。

sentences.en: The ball struck the window and broke it yesterday.
sentences.zh: 球昨天打中窗戶並打破了它。

sentences.en: A big storm struck the island last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天一場大風暴襲擊那座島。

sentences.en: Lightning struck the tall tree during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨中閃電擊中那棵高樹。

sentences.en: In archery class, she hit the target every time.
sentences.zh: 在射箭課上，她每次都射中標靶。

sentences.en: His nose bled after the ball hit his face yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天球打到他的臉之後，他的鼻子流血了。

sentences.en: A dog attacked a little boy in the park yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天有一隻狗在公園攻擊了一個小男孩。

sentences.en: In this game, other players attack you from behind.
sentences.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，其他玩家會從背後攻擊你。

sentences.en: Do not attach anything to this clean wall.
sentences.zh: 不要在這面乾淨的牆上貼任何東西。

sentences.en: Please open the attachment in my e-mail.
sentences.zh: 請打開我電子郵件裡的附件。

sentences.en: He forgot to send the attachment with the file.
sentences.zh: 他忘了把附件跟檔案一起寄出。

sentences.en: She put a cute sticker on her notebook.
sentences.zh: 她在筆記本上貼了一張可愛的貼紙。

sentences.en: The car got stuck in the mud after the rain.
sentences.zh: 雨後車子陷在泥巴裡動不了。

sentences.en: My hands are sticky after eating the candy.
sentences.zh: 吃完糖果後我的手黏黏的。

sentences.en: The sun will rise at six tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 明天早上六點太陽會升起。

sentences.en: Prices always rise before the Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 物價在農曆年前總是上漲。

sentences.en: The river will rise after three days of rain.
sentences.zh: 下了三天雨後河水會上漲。

sentences.en: The teacher praised his creativity in the drawing.
sentences.zh: 老師稱讚他畫作中的創造力。

sentences.en: Teaching children is hard but very rewarding.
sentences.zh: 教小孩很辛苦但很有成就感。

sentences.en: Helping the old man was a rewarding experience.
sentences.zh: 幫助那位老先生是很值得的經驗。

sentences.en: Learning a new language is slow but rewarding.
sentences.zh: 學一種新語言很慢但很值得。

sentences.en: We ate at a local restaurant on our trip last week.
sentences.zh: 上週旅行時，我們在一家當地的餐廳吃飯。

sentences.en: The local news says it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 地方新聞說明天會下雨。

sentences.en: A man approached me on the street yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天有個男人在街上走近我。

sentences.en: The exam is approaching, so I study every night.
sentences.zh: 考試快到了，所以我每天晚上都在讀書。

sentences.en: The man will be in court next Monday.
sentences.zh: 那名男子下週一要上法院。

sentences.en: We play basketball on the court after school.
sentences.zh: 我們放學後在球場打籃球。

sentences.en: Many people believe there is justice in the end.
sentences.zh: 很多人相信最後會有公道。

sentences.en: The lawyer fought for justice for many years.
sentences.zh: 那位律師為了正義奮鬥多年。

sentences.en: The story is about a fight for justice.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講的是為正義而戰。

sentences.en: We should never look down on people who are poor.
sentences.zh: 我們絕不應該瞧不起窮人。

sentences.en: Rich people should not look down on workers.
sentences.zh: 有錢人不應該瞧不起工人。

sentences.en: Do not look down on students with lower grades.
sentences.zh: 不要瞧不起成績比較差的同學。

sentences.en: I had to look up the new word in a dictionary.
sentences.zh: 我得在字典裡查那個生字。

sentences.en: You can look up the meaning on your phone.
sentences.zh: 你可以用手機查意思。

sentences.en: She likes to look up new words after class.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡下課後查生字。

sentences.en: She is not only a singer but also a writer.
sentences.zh: 她不但是歌手，而且是作家。

sentences.en: The soup was not only cheap but also good.
sentences.zh: 那碗湯不但便宜而且好喝。

sentences.en: He not only washed the dishes but also cleaned the floor.
sentences.zh: 他不但洗了碗，還拖了地。

sentences.en: The doctor checked her blood before the test.
sentences.zh: 醫生在檢查前先驗她的血。

sentences.en: The police did a thorough check of the whole building.
sentences.zh: 警方對整棟大樓做了徹底的檢查。

sentences.en: Our guide told us about every food at the night market.
sentences.zh: 我們的導遊跟我們介紹夜市的每一樣食物。

sentences.en: With the coach's guidance, our team played much better.
sentences.zh: 在教練的指導下，我們球隊打得好多了。

sentences.en: A guard stands at the bank door to keep it safe.
sentences.zh: 一名警衛站在銀行門口保護安全。

sentences.en: What is the height of that building?
sentences.zh: 那棟建築物的高度是多少？

sentences.en: The wall is too high for the cat to jump over.
sentences.zh: 那面牆太高了，貓跳不過去。

sentences.en: How high is Taipei 101?
sentences.zh: 台北 101 有多高？

sentences.en: The doctor said my weight is too high.
sentences.zh: 醫生說我的體重太高了。

sentences.en: How much do you weigh now?
sentences.zh: 你現在體重多少？

sentences.en: This box of apples weighs ten kg.
sentences.zh: 這箱蘋果重十公斤。

sentences.en: I didn't realize it was so late.
sentences.zh: 我沒發現已經這麼晚了。

sentences.en: Do you realize how important this test is?
sentences.zh: 你了解這次考試有多重要嗎？

sentences.en: Please do not disturb Grandpa. He is sleeping.
sentences.zh: 請不要打擾爺爺，他在睡覺。

sentences.en: The noise from the street caused a disturbance in class.
sentences.zh: 街上的噪音在課堂上造成了干擾。

sentences.en: Don't bother to wait for me. I will be late.
sentences.zh: 不用費心等我，我會晚到。

sentences.en: Everyone has the ability to learn English well.
sentences.zh: 每個人都有學好英文的能力。

sentences.en: Tom was sick, so he was unable to come to school.
sentences.zh: 湯姆生病了，所以不能來上學。

sentences.en: This bathroom is for old and disabled people.
sentences.zh: 這間廁所是給老人和身障人士用的。

sentences.en: My sister is capable of cooking for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐有能力為全家人煮飯。

sentences.en: This small room has a capacity of twenty people.
sentences.zh: 這間小房間可容納二十人。

sentences.en: The baby is only two months old and incapable of walking.
sentences.zh: 那個嬰兒才兩個月大，還不會走路。

sentences.en: Our trip to the mountains was a big adventure.
sentences.zh: 我們去山上的旅行是一場大冒險。

sentences.en: This game takes you on an exciting adventure.
sentences.zh: 這款遊戲帶你展開一場刺激的冒險。

sentences.en: Driving too fast is a big risk.
sentences.zh: 開車開太快是很大的風險。

sentences.en: Last week, he risked his life to save a child.
sentences.zh: 上週他冒著生命危險去救一個孩子。

sentences.en: Math is challenging for me, but I still like it.
sentences.zh: 數學對我來說很有挑戰性，但我還是喜歡它。

sentences.zh: 爬玉山對我們來說是很大的挑戰。

sentences.zh: 你可以給我一些關於英文考試的建議嗎？

sentences.en: I advise you to take the MRT to the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我建議你搭捷運去動物園。

sentences.en: Mom advised me to bring an umbrella this morning.
sentences.zh: 媽媽今天早上建議我帶雨傘。

sentences.en: Can you suggest a good place for lunch?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦一個吃午餐的好地方嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have any suggestions for our class trip?
sentences.zh: 你對我們的班遊有什麼建議嗎？

sentences.en: My older brother has a big influence on me.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥對我影響很大。

sentences.en: I got the influenza, so I stayed home for three days.
sentences.zh: 我得了流感，所以在家待了三天。

sentences.en: Many students caught influenza last winter, so the school closed.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天很多學生得了流感，所以學校停課。

sentences.en: Mobile games have a strong impact on young people.
sentences.zh: 手機遊戲對年輕人有很大的影響。

sentences.en: The car hit the wall, and the impact broke the window.
sentences.zh: 車子撞上牆，撞擊力把車窗震碎了。

sentences.en: This small bag is made of old jeans.
sentences.zh: 這個小包包是用舊牛仔褲做的。

sentences.en: The old house is made of wood and stone.
sentences.zh: 那間老房子是用木頭和石頭蓋的。

sentences.en: The toy car is made of plastic.
sentences.zh: 那台玩具車是塑膠做的。

sentences.zh: 一個星期由七天組成。

sentences.en: The lunch box consists of rice, fish, and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 這個便當裡有飯、魚和青菜。

sentences.zh: 這次考試包含四十題。

sentences.zh: 這份水果沙拉由蘋果、香蕉和葡萄組成。

sentences.zh: 我們籃球隊由十名球員組成。

sentences.en: The school band is composed of thirty students.
sentences.zh: 學校樂隊由三十個學生組成。

sentences.en: Loud music at night can affect your sleep.
sentences.zh: 晚上大聲的音樂會影響你的睡眠。

sentences.en: She feels deep affection for her little dog.
sentences.zh: 她對她的小狗有很深的感情。

sentences.en: Grandma shows her affection by cooking for us.
sentences.zh: 奶奶用煮飯給我們吃來表達她的關愛。

sentences.en: The typhoon had a big effect on vegetable prices.
sentences.zh: 颱風對菜價有很大的影響。

sentences.zh: 每天練英文十分鐘非常有效。

sentences.zh: 那個藥沒有效，所以我還是覺得不舒服。

sentences.en: Learning English takes time and effort.
sentences.zh: 學英文需要時間和努力。

sentences.en: Thank you for all your effort today.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你今天所有的努力。

sentences.zh: 上個月銷售量下降，所以那家店賠錢了。

sentences.en: I ate less sugar, and my weight decreased by three kg.
sentences.zh: 我少吃糖，體重減少了三公斤。

sentences.zh: 今年社團人數從 20 人增加到 50 人。

sentences.en: The number of students declined last year.
sentences.zh: 去年學生人數下降了。

sentences.zh: 她昨天婉拒來參加我的派對。

sentences.en: My family has a big gathering at New Year.
sentences.zh: 我們家過年時有一場大型聚會。

sentences.zh: 孩子們昨天在海灘上撿貝殼。

sentences.en: I have a bad memory. I often forget names.
sentences.zh: 我記性很差，常常忘記別人的名字。

sentences.en: I need to memorize fifty new words before the test.
sentences.zh: 考試前我需要背五十個新單字。

sentences.en: Our class trip to Kenting was really memorable.
sentences.zh: 我們班的墾丁之旅真的很難忘。

sentences.zh: 飛行員在天空中駕駛飛機。

sentences.zh: 這位飛行員飛機降落得很好。

sentences.zh: 地球是我們居住的行星。

sentences.zh: 有八顆行星繞著太陽轉。

sentences.zh: 我們上週計畫了一趟花蓮之旅。

sentences.zh: 你暑假的計畫是什麼？

sentences.zh: Ben 上週日為媽媽籌劃了一場生日派對。

sentences.zh: 我們班去年春天在學校種了十棵小樹。

sentences.zh: 請每天幫桌上的植物澆水。

sentences.zh: 爸爸去年春天在花園裡種了番茄。

sentences.zh: 這片平原上有很多稻田。

sentences.en: She likes plain clothes without any pictures on them.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡上面沒有任何圖案的樸素衣服。

sentences.zh: 媽媽為客廳買了一幅花的畫。

sentences.zh: 我叔叔是畫家，他畫大海的圖。

sentences.zh: 那兩個男孩很像他們的爸爸，兩個都很高。

u2_lower.title: Ken's Busy Week
u2_lower.text: Ken is an easygoing student in the Food and Beverage Department. He is proud of his talent for cooking. After school, he loves to play Call of Duty and NBA games on his phone. Last month, someone tried to open his game account. Luckily, a strong password kept the account safe. Now Ken uses a longer password to secure it. His mother cannot explain why he loves games so much. To her, it is a mystery. Ken also has a plan. He wants to save one thousand dollars for a new phone, so he stopped buying junk food and drinks. This weekend, he will take a day off from games because he cannot put off his big cooking test. After the test, he will play again at full speed.

u3_upper.title: Leo's First Job
u3_upper.text: Leo is an active student in the Food and Beverage Department. Last summer he got a chance to work at a night market stall. The stall is famous for its cheese toast. On his first day, the owner told him to watch out for the hot oil. Leo felt worried, but he soon became familiar with the job. His work is simple. He takes each order, makes the toast, and cleans the tables. The pay is not high, so Leo will never build great wealth here. Still, he does not worry about it. He decided to save part of the money for a basketball camp. His parents' only concern is his health, because he sleeps late every night. Leo knows they are right. Next month he will choose an earlier shift.

u3_lower.title: Mina's Last Game
u3_lower.text: Mina is the point guard of our school team. Her coach is tough but kind. Before the city game, he warned the players about the hot weather. The heat was terrible that day, and some of them felt tired. Mina had to bear the pain in her knee, but she did not stop. Her goal was simple. She wanted to win for her school. In the second half, our team lacked energy. Then a big crowd of students began to shout. They gave the team a big hand after every point. Mina hit her target and made the last shot. Everyone got up from their seats. It was a pleasant evening for all of us. To many students, Mina is now a symbol of courage.

u4_upper.title: Ken's First Job
u4_upper.text: Ken finished his education last summer, but for months he was out of work. He did not boast about himself. He was honest and worked hard every day. One morning, a chain store called him for an interview. Ken was about to leave home when his mother gave him a gold pen for luck. At the interview, the interviewer asked many questions. Ken kept his answers in order and did not talk too much, because too much talk can do harm. His honesty soon gained the manager's trust. "Perhaps you are the one we need," the manager said. The store would provide good training and supply a free lunch every day. Ken felt no more pain in his stomach. It was a great honor to get his first real job.

u4_lower.title: The Magic Show
u4_lower.text: Last month, our science club had a big discussion about a school show. My favorite subject is science, so I joined right away. We wanted a fun idea, no matter how hard it was. Sam, who is good at magic, said he could be the magician. He kept his plan a secret, like a code. On the show day, we were all in good shape. Sam used a sharp knife to cut an apple and then divided the pieces among the crowd. The apples were smooth, not rough. Suddenly, a real rabbit appeared on the table! We had to feed it and keep it alive backstage. After the show, many students looked for us to say thank you. That night I had a sore throat from shouting, but I did not care. We still hear from those happy students today.

u5_upper.title: Ben the Star Player
u5_upper.text: Ben is an outstanding baseball player on our school team. Last year, a bad loss almost made the team panic. But Ben stayed calm. In fact, he believed that hard work is the main factor of success. After class, he did research on famous pitchers and copied their skills. He was patient and never gave up, even when his arm was in great pain. To him, the letters on his shirt stand for honor. This year, Ben can pitch the ball very fast, and he helped the team win again. The whole school took action to cheer for him. It did not matter that he once failed. What matters is that he recovered and became a star. Ben's story shows that patience and skill can help anyone stand out.

u5_lower.title: My First Talent Show
u5_lower.text: Last month, our school put up a notice about a talent show in the hall. I felt some anxiety at first, because I am always nervous in front of people. My friend Amy helped me pick a song, and we had to sit up late every night to practice. She saved all our songs in a class album. On the show day, the lobby was full of parents. A heavy box blocked the door, so we tried to pick up the box together. Someone forgot to turn on the bright lights, and I waited alone on the stage. But my loneliness went away when the music started. The judges said my voice was notable. One of them was a noble singer who told me that music is a language of the heart. Now I know that practice can discover something new in anyone.

u6_upper.title: Our Graduation Trip
u6_upper.text: Last summer, our class went to Kenting for a graduation trip. Our teacher asked us to think of a plan by ourselves. Amy found a coupon for a cheap hotel, and I sent a message to confirm the rooms. When we arrived, we had to check in at the front desk, and the clerk had to check up on every name one by one. The hotel did not allow us to cook, so we ate raw fish at a night market instead. The next morning, we surfed at the beach and walked to the peak of a small hill. Nobody discouraged us, even when the rain started. Amy made a short film about the whole trip. Now that film is a reminder of our happiest days together.

u6_lower.title: The Sports Day We Waited For
u6_lower.text: Last Friday, our school planned a big sports day. The sky was dark, and a tiny drop of rain fell on my hand. Soon the news spread that the teachers might call off the games. Many students began to complain, because our team wanted a victory this year. Mr. Lin did not want to frighten us, so he stayed calm and said nothing. During the last period, the loud speaker came on, and he read a short list of items for the new plan. The games would move to next Monday, and no one could force him to change it. In the end, nobody argued about the new date. On my way home, I decided to drop by Amy's house. Her old dog looked almost dead on the floor after a long walk. We laughed, and my bad mood was gone.

u7_upper.title: The Missing Computer
u7_upper.text: Last month, someone stole the new computer in our school office. The teachers asked the police to look into the case. Two officers came to look over every classroom, and they inspected the windows and doors carefully. At first, everyone in my class was a suspect except me, because I was sick at home that day. The police said the person who did it committed a serious crime. Three days later, they arrested a young man near the night market and put him in jail. He was not a murderer, but he expected easy money. Our school is not perfect, but the teachers did an excellent job that week. Since then, our teacher reminds us to lock the office door every day. Now we all look forward to a safer school.

u7_lower.title: The Game We Won
u7_lower.text: Last Saturday, our school held a local basketball game on the outdoor court. Before the game, our coach told us not to look down on the other team. We were not only tired but also nervous. In the first half, a tall player hit my arm by accident and injured my hand. The wound was small, so I put a bandage on it and kept playing. Our team raised the score little by little. When the last minute approached, I threw the ball hard and it went in. The judge blew the whistle, and everyone stood up to praise us. Our coach gave each of us a small reward after the game. That night I had to look up the word "champion" in my dictionary.

u8_upper.title: Our New Coach
u8_upper.text: Our school basketball team is made up of twelve players. Last month, a new coach came to guide us. He is not very tall, but his height is not a problem. He has the ability to find every small mistake. On the first day, he checked our weight and gave us some advice about food. He suggested more fish, eggs, and fruit. Our practices consist of running, shooting, and passing, and every practice is a big challenge. At first, some players wanted to quit. Then we won three games in a row, and we realized the coach was right. His influence on the team is really big. Before every game, he says, "Don't be afraid to take a risk." Now we are capable of beating the best team in our city. For us, every season is a new adventure.

u8_lower.title: Kevin's Big Lunch
u8_lower.text: Kevin is a student in the food program at a high school in Tainan. He takes after his mother. She is a great cook, and he wants to go after his dream of opening a small restaurant. Last month his class planned a lunch for the old people in town. The students gathered in the school kitchen early in the morning. Kevin made soup with plants from the school garden. He cooked the beef slowly to soften it. His friend Amy painted the menu on a plain white board. At first, one thing puzzled them: how could they make the food less salty? They decreased the salt and used more fresh vegetables. Their effort had a good effect. The old people loved the meal, and one man said it brought back a happy memory. Kevin will take care of the kitchen again next month.

u9_upper.title: The Bus That Broke Down
u9_upper.text: Last Saturday our basketball team took a bus to a game in Taichung. On the highway, the old bus broke down. All the passengers got off and waited beside the road. Our coach called a mechanic, and he arrived in an hour. While we waited, we took a short break under a tree and shared two boxes of rice balls. A couple of players practiced shooting at an old basket near a store. Some of us were afraid the trip would break up, but the mechanic fixed the engine before noon. We got to the gym ten minutes before the game, and the school band was still on the stage. Our team won by two points, and the satisfaction was really big. That night, numerous fans left messages on our school website.

u9_lower.title: The Typhoon Night
u9_lower.text: Last September a strong typhoon hit our town. The weather forecast said it would come after midnight, and every TV station broadcast the news all day. At the supermarket, people squeezed into the aisles to buy food and batteries. That night the wind was crazy. The power went out at ten, so our air-conditioner stopped and the room got hot. A small fire broke out in a shop down the street, but the firemen put it out in ten minutes. My little brother cut his finger on a broken cup. He saw the blood and almost passed out. In the morning, the news said the water almost broke through the old dam near the border of our city. Cleaning the streets was difficult, but our neighbors shared their tools and finished the work by noon.

u10_upper.title: International Night
u10_upper.text: Our school held an international night last Friday. Along with students from Japan and Vietnam, our class cooked a balanced meal of rice, meat, and vegetables. At first I was too shy to utter a word, but I soon made friends with two exchange students. They asked me about the cultural meaning of moon cakes, and I did my best to express the idea in English. One student took photos of every dish, so I asked him for a favor: to send them to our class group. In our haste to clean up, we almost had an accident with a pot of hot soup. Luckily nobody got hurt, and we did not waste any food. Our teacher said our class got along with the guests better than average.

u10_lower.title: The Cooking Class Dinner
u10_lower.text: My cousin studies in the cooking course of a vocational high school. Last month his class made dinner for the parents. Their teacher is a master of Chinese food, and he never mentions his own awards. That morning the kitchen was awful: the automatic oven stopped working and the fish was not fresh. The students had to alter the menu through a quick meeting. They communicated in short sentences and finished on time. In total, they cooked six dishes for forty people. Classical music played, and cherry blossoms on the tables made the room pretty. Parents surrounded my cousin and asked for his recipes. The teacher told them to get in touch with him by e-mail. My cousin did not show off, but I could see he was proud.

u11_upper.title: A Day on the Solar Farm
u11_upper.text: Last month our class visited a farm that runs on solar energy. The owner is a charming old man who can handle every machine by himself. He told us that the farm grows two crops a year, and the harvest in October is the biggest one. We helped him collect eggs, and the smell in the henhouse was a slight problem for some of us. After lunch, one student left a candle near a paper box, and a small fire started. The owner put out the fire in a second and asked us to blow out every candle before we left. Our classroom at school is often a mess, but on the farm we cleaned everything. To our delight, the owner gave each of us a bag of rice.

u11_lower.title: My Cousin's War Game
u11_lower.text: My cousin plays a war game every night. In the game, players join a military team, move their troops, and capture the enemy's base. Each battle takes about ten minutes. Every player can pick a weapon, but the game is fair: everyone starts with the same money. Last week my cousin created his own map. He is very creative, and other players said his map was worth trying. Some of them said the old maps were worse. His room is always in a mess when he plays, so his mother asks him to put away his clothes and cups first. She cannot put up with the noise, either. My cousin has faith in his own plan: he wants to study computer science and create games for a living.

u12_upper.title: My Aunt the Nurse
u12_upper.text: My aunt works as a nurse in a small hospital. Her schedule is full: she works ten hours a day and often has no time for lunch. Last week a woman with cancer came to her floor. The woman had to take five pills every morning, and her son had to fill out many forms at the front desk. My aunt helped him find out where to pay. On Friday the hospital canceled a big meeting because a fire alarm went off. Nobody knew how it occurred, but everyone had to escape down the stairs in one minute. My aunt was the last one out. She says the job is hard, but it fulfills her dream of helping people. The waiting room is always filled with worried faces, and she supports them with a smile.

u12_lower.title: The Old Temple Trip
u12_lower.text: Our history teacher took us to an old temple in the central area of Tainan. The temple is more than two hundred years old, and many people go there to worship every month. Inside, we saw Chinese characters carved on a big wooden board. Our teacher said the work took three years. She gave us a clue and asked us to find the name of the god on the wall; the first hint was the color red. She also asked, "Are you with me?" before every long explanation. Then Ken wanted to shake the fortune sticks, but the temple was closing. On the way home, our school vehicle broke down. It was nobody's fault; the bus was simply old. We could not figure out why it stopped, so we waited an hour.
